description_en: Queries the details of a specified stack group operation in an Alibaba Cloud region
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询指定资源栈组的操作详情
name: GetStackGroupOperation

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈组所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The operation ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151342.html operation to obtain the operation ID
parameters.name: operation_id

StackGroupOperation.description_en: The details of the stack group operation

Action.description_en:
The operation action. Valid values:

CREATE: create

UPDATE: update

DELETE: delete

DETECT_DRIFT: drift detection
Action.description_zh:
操作动作。

取值：

CREATE：创建。

UPDATE：更新。

DELETE：删除。

DETECT_DRIFT：偏差检测

AdministrationRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM administrator role assumed by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) when you create a stack group with self-managed permissions. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole is returned
AdministrationRoleName.description_zh: 创建自助管理权限模式的资源栈组时，指定的供ROS扮演的RAM管理员角色名称。若不指定，则默认返回AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole

CreateTime.description_en: The start time of the operation

DeploymentTargets.description_en: The deployment targets of stack instances when the service-managed permissions mode is used
DeploymentTargets.description_zh: 使用服务管理权限模式时，资源栈实例的部署目标

AccountIds.description_en:
The IDs of the member accounts in the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only when you call the [UpdateStackInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151716.html） operation to update stack instances and specify the AccountIds request parameter
AccountIds.description_zh:
资源目录中的成员账号ID列表。

仅在您调用[UpdateStackInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151716.html）执行更新资源栈实例操作时，指定了请求参数AccountIds，此处才会返回该参数

items.description_en:
The IDs of the member accounts in the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only when you call the [UpdateStackInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151716.html） operation to update stack instances and specify the AccountIds request parameter
items.description_zh:
资源目录中的成员账号ID列表。

仅在您调用[UpdateStackInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151716.html）执行更新资源栈实例操作时，指定了请求参数AccountIds，此处才会返回该参数

RdFolderIds.description_en: The IDs of the folders in the resource directory
RdFolderIds.description_zh: 资源目录的资源夹ID列表

items.description_en: The IDs of the folders in the resource directory
items.description_zh: 资源目录的资源夹ID列表

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the operation

ExecutionRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM execution role assumed by the administrator role (AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole) when you create a stack group with self-managed permissions. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole is returned
ExecutionRoleName.description_zh: 创建自助管理权限模式的资源栈组时，需指定的供管理员角色（AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole）扮演的RAM执行角色名称。若不指定，则默认返回AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole

OperationDescription.description_en:
The operation description.

This parameter is returned only when you call the [CreateStackInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151338.html） operation to create stack instances and specify the OperationDescription request parameter
OperationDescription.description_zh:
操作描述。

仅在您调用[CreateStackInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151338.html）执行创建资源栈实例操作时，指定了请求参数OperationDescription，此处才会返回该参数

FailureToleranceCount.description_en:
The failure tolerance count. This is the number of accounts in which stack deployments can fail in each region before the operation stops in the region. If the operation stops in a region, it does not continue in other regions. Valid values: 0 to 20.

Only one of the FailureToleranceCount and FailureTolerancePercentage parameters is returned
FailureToleranceCount.description_zh:
容错数。每个地域中资源栈可以失败的账号数，超过该数字将停止该地域中的操作。如果停止了一个地域中的操作，此操作在其他地域中不继续执行。

取值范围：0~20。

只能返回FailureToleranceCount和FailureTolerancePercentage其中一个参数

FailureTolerancePercentage.description_en:
The failure tolerance percentage. This is the percentage of accounts in which stack deployments can fail in each region out of the total number of accounts before the operation stops in the region. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Only one of the FailureToleranceCount and FailureTolerancePercentage parameters is returned
FailureTolerancePercentage.description_zh:
容错百分比。每个地域中资源栈可以失败的账号数占总账号数的百分比，超过该百分比将停止该地域中的操作。

取值范围：0~100。

只能返回FailureToleranceCount和FailureTolerancePercentage其中一个参数

MaxConcurrentCount.description_en:
The maximum concurrent accounts. This is the number of accounts in which stack deployment can be performed concurrently in each region. Valid values: 1 to 20.

Only one of the MaxConcurrentCount and MaxConcurrentPercentage parameters is returned
MaxConcurrentCount.description_zh:
最大并发账号数。每个地域中可同时部署资源栈的账号数。

取值范围：1~20。

只能返回MaxConcurrentCount和MaxConcurrentPercentage其中一个参数

MaxConcurrentPercentage.description_en:
The maximum percentage of concurrent accounts. This is the percentage of accounts in which stacks can be deployed concurrently in each region out of the total number of accounts. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Only one of the MaxConcurrentCount and MaxConcurrentPercentage parameters is returned
MaxConcurrentPercentage.description_zh:
最大并发账号百分比。每个地域中可同时部署资源栈的账号数占总账号数的百分比。

取值范围：1~100。

只能返回MaxConcurrentCount和MaxConcurrentPercentage其中一个参数

RegionIdsOrder.description_en: The list of regions in the order of execution for the operation
RegionIdsOrder.description_zh: 操作中按执行顺序排列的地域列表

items.description_en: The list of regions in the order of execution for the operation
items.description_zh: 操作中按执行顺序排列的地域列表

RetainStacks.description_en:
Indicates whether to retain stacks. When you delete a stack instance, you can choose to delete or retain the stack to which the instance points. Valid values:

true: Only the stack instance is deleted, and the corresponding stack is retained.

false: Both the stack instance and the corresponding stack are deleted. Proceed with caution.

This parameter is returned only when you delete a stack instance
RetainStacks.description_zh:
是否保留资源栈。删除资源栈实例时可选择删除或保留它所指向的资源栈。

取值：

true：只删除资源栈实例，不删除相应的资源栈。

false：删除资源栈实例和相应的资源栈，请您谨慎操作。

仅在您执行删除资源栈实例的操作时，才会返回该参数

StackGroupDriftDetectionDetail.description_en:
The drift detection details.

This parameter is returned only when you perform a drift detection operation
StackGroupDriftDetectionDetail.description_zh:
偏差检测的详情。

仅在您执行偏差检测的操作时，才会返回该参数

CancelledStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances for which drift detection is canceled
CancelledStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 取消偏差检测的资源栈实例的数量

DriftDetectionStatus.description_en:
The drift detection status. Valid values:
COMPLETED: Drift detection on the stack group is complete, and drift detection on all stack instances succeeded.
FAILED: Drift detection on the stack group is complete, and the number of stack instances for which drift detection failed exceeds the specified threshold.
PARTIAL_SUCCESS: Drift detection on the stack group is complete, and drift detection on some stack instances failed, but the number of failed instances does not exceed the threshold.
IN_PROGRESS: Drift detection on the stack group is in progress.
STOPPED: Drift detection on the stack group is canceled by the user
DriftDetectionStatus.description_zh:
偏差检测状态。

取值：
COMPLETED：资源栈组偏差检测结束，所有资源栈实例均成功完成了偏差检测。
FAILED：资源栈组偏差检测结束，失败的资源栈实例偏差检测数量超过了设定的阈值。
PARTIAL_SUCCESS：资源栈组偏差检测结束，部分资源栈实例偏差检测失败，但失败数量没有超过阈值。
IN_PROGRESS：资源栈组偏差检测进行中。
STOPPED：用户取消了资源栈组的偏差检测

DriftDetectionTime.description_en: The time when drift detection was performed. The time follows the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format
DriftDetectionTime.description_zh: 偏差检测时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

DriftedStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances that have drifted
DriftedStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 处于偏差状态的资源栈实例的数量

FailedStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances for which drift detection failed
FailedStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 偏差检测失败的资源栈实例的数量

InProgressStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances for which drift detection is in progress
InProgressStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 偏差检测中的资源栈实例的数量

InSyncStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances that are in sync
InSyncStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 处于同步状态的资源栈实例的数量

StackGroupDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift status of the stack group. Valid values:
DRIFTED: At least one stack instance has drifted.
NOT_CHECKED: No successful drift detection has been performed on the stack group.
IN_SYNC: All stack instances are in sync
StackGroupDriftStatus.description_zh:
资源栈组偏差状态。

取值：
DRIFTED：至少一个资源栈实例处于偏差状态。
NOT_CHECKED：资源栈组未进行过成功的偏差检测。
IN_SYNC：所有资源栈实例均处于同步状态

TotalStackInstancesCount.description_en: The total number of stack instances

Status.description_en:
The operation status. Valid values:

RUNNING: The operation is in progress.

SUCCEEDED: The operation succeeded.

FAILED: The operation failed.

STOPPING: The operation is being stopped.

STOPPED: The operation is stopped
Status.description_zh:
操作状态。

取值：

RUNNING：操作正在进行中。

SUCCEEDED：操作成功。

FAILED：操作失败。

STOPPING：操作正在停止中。

STOPPED：操作已停止
